notice.title: New: Plan update {date}
page.intro: Your plan only changes when you press Apply. Below you see what changes, why, and what it does to your own next 4 weeks.
page.safe: Logged sessions and past days never change.
page.legend: Only changed days are marked: old struck through, new next to it.
page.noChanges: Nothing changes in your next 4 weeks. The update may still have an effect later, for example in your taper.
page.forecastSame: Your forecast and your chance to hit your goal stay the same.
page.applied: Applied on {date}. You can always go back via Settings → Plan history.
page.dismissed: You chose ‘Not now’. Your plan has not changed; you can still apply the update here at any time.
page.rolledBack: You rolled this update back. You can apply it again.
page.alreadyIn: Your plan already follows these rules.
page.toastDismissed: Your plan stays as it is
page.notFound: This plan update does not exist or has not been published yet.
field.title: session
history.intro: Every time your plan switches rules, we keep a version. You can always go back to an earlier version, as often as you like.
rollback.title: Back to version {n}
rollback.intro: From today your plan goes back to the rules of version {n} (rule set {v}). This is what changes in your next 4 weeks.
rollback.same: Version {n} uses the same rules as your current plan. Restoring it changes nothing.
sci.sourcesIntro: Every source with its level and the rules in your plan it supports. Sources are never deleted: outdated sources are listed at the bottom under Archived.
sci.levels: Level A = meta-analysis or systematic review · B = controlled study · C = small or uncontrolled study · D = consensus, practice or expert opinion
sci.changelogIntro: When new research changes a rule, every member first gets a before/after of their own plan and chooses.
sci.noUpdates: No plan updates yet: all plans follow rule set 1.
